entities.name: František Plesnivý
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: František Plesnivý was a Czech architect known for his Art Nouveau early designs and utilitarian later designs. Among his many buildings are Ettrichova Vila (1873), the Jaroměř house featured prominently in Jan Hřebejk's 2000 film Divided We Fall, which during the late 19th century was frequented by such admirers as Emperor Franz Joseph I, and the Lederer & Adler "mechanical shoe factory" in Litomyšl (1910).
